security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Community desktop interface for the Codex CLI
bundle.longDescription: TuxCodex is an unofficial interface for an installed Codex CLI, with project switching, Git review, and local file previews. Codex handles AI requests and authentication. Developed by Moussa Kassim Mohame and Stefano Cacciatore.
